name: TensorFold
description: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.
one_liner: A fast engine for running AI language models directly on your own Mac or PC — no Python needed — instead of paying a cloud AI provider per token.
buyer: A developer or small company that wants to run AI models locally for privacy or cost reasons instead of paying ongoing cloud API fees.
business_use_cases: A privacy-focused startup runs it on-prem to serve an internal AI chatbot without sending data to a cloud AI provider.
An indie AI app developer uses it to cut inference costs by self-hosting instead of paying per-token API fees.
A hardware reseller bundles it into a 'local AI workstation' sold to small businesses wanting private AI without ongoing API bills.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a pre-configured 'local AI box' (hardware plus TensorFold plus a model) to businesses wanting private, offline AI

steal_this: Build and sell a turnkey 'private AI mini-server' for small businesses who want chatbot-style AI without sending data to the cloud.
note: Its README contains instructions aimed at AI coding agents to install and run a third-party 'Agent Traffic Control' tool before editing the repo — that is a prompt-injection-style instruction embedded in repo content, not a request from our own operator, and was not followed.
